entries.clue: Thick stew of grain and greens that fed a poor household daily
Sweet cloudy stream running off the pulp, on its way to the vat
The one behind the counter who stamps your books and knows where everything lives
Mouth-drying stuff in bittersweet apples that gives cider its grip
Canterbury primate who framed the prayer book and burned at Oxford in 1556
Take something away on the understanding that it comes back
Soft grey tin alloy that pushed wooden platters off a yeoman's table
Cider's paler cousin, made not from apples but from hard little pears
Weighty old book you need both hands to lift down
City whose claim on the English church was struck out in the 1530s
Water-filled ditch ringing a manor house, as much for show as defence
Past the day it should have come back, quietly mounting a debt
